components.what: Paper section 2.3, section 3.1 and Fig 1: a continual learner alternates Wake (takes external data) and Sleep (no external input; works on internal knowledge). Harness reading: an offline pass over project memory, kept separate from task sessions.
components.oaw_target: scripts/wiki_sync.py memory-check (knowledge profile): one manual, read-only, offline pass over .agents/memory.md. It reports missing_path (a cited project path is not in the current tree; removal_context flag) and outside_project (cannot be checked), so a human can decide whether an entry has been superseded. Tests in tests/test_wiki_sync.py MemoryCheckTests; docs in docs/Wiki_Sync_Guide.md#memory-citation-check-prototype and docs/CLI_Reference.md.
components.reason: This is the only part of the cycle that maps onto a harness with no daemon, hook, scheduler or model call. It is an analogy only: the paper's Sleep consolidates actively with self-generated data, while memory-check only reports. It reuses _parse_memory_entries, follows the read-only advisory precedent of promote-candidates, and lives in wiki_sync.py rather than context_hub.py. That keeps the default command surface unchanged (Small defaults) and avoids the os.makedirs side effect at context_hub.py:818. Release wording: parity, no improvement claimed.

components.what: CMS: a chain of MLP blocks, each updated at its own frequency (Eq. 1-2). Fig 4 varies the number of levels (1-4) and the lowest consolidation frequency (512/2K/8K).

steps: Run memory-check --json on each owner-named project (0 model tokens). If the named projects have fewer than 50 entries in total, record 'not measured' and stop.

Two goldfish label every non-removal-context missing_path finding as useful or not useful, independently and blind to the tool's rationale. Useful means the entry needs a supersede note or a reader should be warned. A finding counts as useful only if both labelers say so. The Elephant does not label, because it built the tool. Removal-context findings are labeled the same way and reported separately.
T0.gate: absorb candidate if precision of non-removal-context missing_path findings >= 0.7 AND at least 1 useful finding per 50 entries; otherwise excrete via the D12 restore point. Report n and the 95% Wilson lower bound (reporting only; the gate does not change).
T0.also_report: the outside_project / unanchored / unverified counts; skipped CJK-named path citations the labelers notice (the recall exclusion); findings on already-superseded entries once OAW-20 exists
T0.estimate: 0 tokens for the run; about 1.2-1.8M for labeling (2 agent runs per batch of up to about 100 findings; estimate); 0 tokens if the owner labels
T0.needs: the owner to name which projects' .agents/memory.md may be read (privacy, beyond the D11 policy)

T1.plan: no test. Revisit only if P2prime is absorbed and a scheduled run is requested; then it is a consent decision about publishing memory, not a value test.

T2.needs: OAW-20 (memory add --supersedes), PRE-05 fixture W, PRE-01; Codex half also needs PRE-03
T2.stage0: Free and deterministic. Build a variant of fixture W with supersede chains (Elephant drafts it, a goldfish reviews it). Register the archive rule (entries superseded by a later --supersedes entry) and its sha256 before any run. Measure (a) the number of gold questions whose recall top-5 or bootstrap output contains a superseded entry the rule would archive, and (b) the bytes saved. Stop rule: if (a) = 0 and (b) < 5%, excrete with no paid run.
T2.stage1: Claude screen: 20 questions x 2 arms (OAW with supersede markers vs. plus archiving) x 3 repeats = 120 runs. If co-registered with HOLD-01/HOLD-03, the baseline arm is shared (60 runs).
T2.falsifier: excrete, however many tokens it saves, if gold accuracy drops or wrong-scope misuse rises; also excrete if accuracy does not rise and token reduction is under 5%
T2.estimate: stage0 about 1.2-1.8M (fixture variant authoring and review); stage1 about 72-108M, or about 36-54M with a shared baseline; Codex half re-estimated after the screen

T3.needs: the catalog P4 regression suite (R1) and PRE-01
T3.stage0: One goldfish writes 10 cases blind to any candidate, a second goldfish reviews them, and the Elephant maps each case to the behaviors the existing suite covers. Stop rule: if no case adds coverage, excrete.
T3.stage1a: Noise calibration on the baseline release: 10 cases x 5 repeats = 50 runs. Drop cases with p < 0.8. This calibration doubles as P4's R4 calibration.
T3.stage1b: Three seeded regressions, built to fall outside the existing suite's coverage, x 10 cases x 3 repeats = 90 runs. Stop rule: if the new cases catch none of them, excrete.
T3.estimate: stage0 about 1.8-2.7M; stage1a about 30-45M (shared with P4); stage1b about 54-81M
